One multilingual voice carries all three languages; the languages fact confirms the es and zh-Hans audio is in the right language, so the narration is not English read over a translated page.

The subtitles fact lists captions for segments 1-7 in all three languages. At 1280x800 the caption bar under the video is legible in all three (guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png, guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png), with a Captions / Subtítulos / 字幕 toggle checked and the spoken word highlighted. At 375x812 the transcript under the player carries the same highlight (guide-en-phone.png "after", guide-es-phone.png "después", guide-zh-Hans-phone.png "天后，"), which is the chosen phone layout. No caption text is cut off. The Chinese highlight spans "天后，" rather than "两天后", a word-segmentation nicety, not a readability problem.

The toc fact lists 7 chapters and every jump landed exactly on its chapter start (0, 12.4, 37.44, 61.92, 77.68, 101.28, 129.36), with the right chapter active each time, and all seven visible at 1280x800 in all three languages. The languages fact matched the expected Spanish and Mandarin first sentences and reports audio in es and zh-Hans with no error status. The screenshots show the whole page turning over, not just the text: title, Idioma / 语言 selector, chapter titles, transcript, player controls (Reproducir / 播放, Velocidad / 速度, Subtítulos / 字幕), the call-for-help block, the print link and the picture labels are all in the chosen language in guide-es-desktop.png, guide-es-phone.png, guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-phone.png. No English is left in the Spanish or Mandarin views. The provider_file fact reports two steps (paste the block, copy the link), 20 ms from paste to link, zero account or login fields, and no network requests after load, so nothing asks a provider to sign in or install anything. provider-draft.png shows the pasted draft dot phrase with its *** placeholders and a table with Antibiotic, Pain medication, Follow-up and Language, each offering its preset ("Use the draft default (Yes)", "Use "about two weeks"", "Use the draft default (English)") next to a Yes/No or date override, and each saying plainly why it will not guess from a *** line. provider-filled.png shows the same table reading a filled block: Antibiotic No, Pain medication Yes, Follow-up 10/01/2026, Language Español, each marked "your block", and guide-from-link.png shows that link opening the guide in Spanish with "Su revisión de la herida y examen del oído: 1 de octubre de 2026" in the transcript. The card_summary fact reports the card reachable at status 200 and on the first screen at both widths. guide-en-desktop.png shows "Print the card" in the header; guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png and guide-zh-Hans-phone.png show "Print the card" / "Imprimir la tarjeta" / "打印卡片" under the player without scrolling.
